content_blocks.title: Practice reasoning
content_blocks.text: Grid search compares a predeclared set of parameter choices using cross-validation. Keep a final test set untouched until the model-selection procedure is complete. For hyperparameter optimization strategy, keep the problem definition, data selection, estimator configuration, and evaluation criterion explicit. When results are uncertain, compare a baseline and inspect examples rather than treating one metric as a complete explanation.

content_blocks.code:
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.svm import SVC
X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
search = GridSearchCV(SVC(), {"C": [0.1, 1, 10]}, cv=StratifiedKFold(3), scoring="accuracy")
search.fit(X, y)
print(search.best_params_["C"] in [0.1, 1, 10])
